name: Pip the Street Urchin
description: A quick-witted street child who sees and hears everything in Gearhaven.

initial_greeting.text: Spare a coin, mister Detective? I got eyes everywhere. Bet I seen things you'd like to know about.

helpful.text: Thanks, mister! I seen the Professor the night he died. He was running, scared-like. Men in fancy coats were chasing him. He ducked into his workshop. Then I heard shouting, breaking glass. Then nothing. I ran.

information.text: Might remember something if my memory was jogged. Coins help memory, you know.
